tool_args.rationale: The five pilot observations have a narrow s_grad span of 0.018. The open-branch probe can distinguish the coupled base parameters and local branch before fitting across the full wide fallback box.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the smooth siphon model to the pilot alone
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The narrow s_grad range makes vmax and rho nearly collinear, so their individual effects are not reliably identified.
The lower-cost open-branch probe directly adds the needed s_grad leverage.
The pilot is monotonically increasing, with no observed high-u decline.
